subject: Charged twice this month
body: Hi, I just checked my bank statement and I was charged $49 twice on October 3rd for the same Pro subscription. Please refund the duplicate charge.

subject: Need invoice for September
body: Could you send me a PDF invoice for September with our company VAT number included? Our accounting team needs it by end of month.

subject: Refund request after cancellation
body: I cancelled my plan on day 2 of the billing cycle but was billed for the whole month. Your policy says pro-rated refunds apply. Can you process it?

subject: Update credit card
body: My card expires next week. How do I change the payment method on file so my service isn't interrupted?

subject: Downgrade plan
body: We want to move from Enterprise to Pro starting next billing cycle. What happens to the extra seats we already paid for?

subject: Payment failed - account suspended
body: Our payment failed overnight and now the whole team is locked out of the workspace. 120 people can't work. We need this restored immediately, we'll pay right now.

subject: Cobro incorrecto en mi factura
body: Hola, en la factura de este mes aparece un cargo adicional de 30 USD que no reconozco. ¿Me pueden explicar a qué corresponde?

subject: Tax exemption certificate
body: We are a registered non-profit. Where can we upload our tax-exemption certificate so sales tax is removed from future invoices?

subject: Production API returning 500
body: Since 09:40 UTC every call to /v2/orders returns HTTP 500. Our checkout is down and we are losing sales every minute. Request id: 7f3a-22c1.

subject: App crashes on login
body: The mobile app (iOS 18, version 4.2.1) crashes right after I enter my credentials. Reinstalling didn't help.

subject: Slow dashboard loading
body: The analytics dashboard takes about 40 seconds to load since yesterday. It used to be instant. Other pages are fine.

subject: Webhook not firing
body: Our Slack integration stopped receiving webhook events for new tickets. The endpoint is reachable and returns 200 when tested manually.

subject: CSV export has broken characters
body: When I export reports to CSV, accented characters like é and ñ show up as garbage in Excel.

subject: Error al sincronizar datos
body: Desde la actualización de ayer, la sincronización con nuestro ERP falla con el error 'timeout after 30s'. Tenemos pedidos sin procesar.

subject: Typo in settings page
body: Minor thing: the settings page says 'Notifcations' instead of 'Notifications'.

subject: Rate limit too aggressive
body: We keep hitting 429 errors at around 50 requests per minute, but our plan is supposed to allow 300. Is something misconfigured on our account?

subject: Can't reset my password
body: I requested a password reset three times but never received the email. I checked spam too.

subject: Lost access to MFA device
body: I lost my phone and can't get past two-factor authentication. I'm the only admin on our account.

subject: Add new users to workspace
body: How do I invite 5 new colleagues to our workspace and give two of them admin rights?

subject: Close my account
body: Please close my account. I no longer use the service.

subject: Change account owner
body: Our previous admin left the company. We need to transfer account ownership to me, the new IT manager.

subject: No puedo iniciar sesión
body: Me aparece 'usuario bloqueado' cuando intento entrar. No recuerdo haber fallado la contraseña muchas veces.

subject: SSO login loop
body: After enabling SAML SSO with Okta, all our users get stuck in a redirect loop and nobody can log in.

subject: Feature request: dark mode
body: It would be great to have a dark mode, I use the app late at night a lot.

subject: How to schedule reports
body: Is there a way to automatically email the weekly report to my manager every Monday?

subject: Bulk edit request
body: We manage thousands of records and editing them one by one is painful. Any plans for bulk editing? This is blocking our renewal decision.

subject: Onboarding help
body: We just signed up. Is there a guide or a call available to help us set up our first project?

subject: ¿Se puede integrar con Google Sheets?
body: Queremos enviar los datos automáticamente a Google Sheets. ¿Existe una integración o está en el roadmap?

subject: Feedback on new editor
body: The new editor is much harder to use than the old one. Several of our team members are frustrated. Can we switch back?

subject: Suspicious login from another country
body: I got an alert about a login from Russia that wasn't me. I changed my password but I'm worried data was accessed.

subject: Phishing email using your brand
body: I received an email that looks like it's from you asking me to 'verify billing details' on a weird domain. Forwarding it so you can act.

subject: GDPR data deletion request
body: Under GDPR Article 17, I request deletion of all personal data you hold about me.

subject: Vulnerability report
body: I found a stored XSS in the comments field of shared projects. I can provide a PoC privately. Do you have a disclosure program?

subject: SOC 2 report request
body: Our security team needs your latest SOC 2 Type II report before we can sign the contract.

subject: Solicitud de acceso a mis datos
body: Conforme al RGPD, solicito una copia de todos los datos personales que tienen sobre mí.

subject: Something wrong with my account and bill
body: My account looks weird and I think the bill is wrong too. Please help.

subject: Locked out after payment change
body: I updated my credit card and right after that I couldn't log in anymore. Is this related?

subject: Data missing after export
body: I exported my data to delete my account but half the projects are missing from the file.

subject: Someone changed our plan
body: Our plan was upgraded to Enterprise and none of the admins did it. Was our account compromised or is this a billing error?

subject: Need help ASAP
body: Nothing works. Please call me.
